items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: he said, 'Listen, I'm going to take a band in and gee, if you want the cornet part, you come on and join up.' So, I did that for awhile.

ctx.x: Yeah, but I went--- then I got a chance -- I knew a drummer and his name - if Ann were here she could tell me the name of that drummer - but, anyway, we went in a club right almost across from my hotel called the "Club Myerdor" and it was run by one of the mob guys and, uh, we went until like six or seven in the morning. We started at eleven at night. And, we had a floor show to play and it had dancing girls and they had adagio dancers and comedians and it was a marvelous thing. And, I got that through this…

Who was from Gary, Indiana and I met him on one of the jobs with Benson guys -- he said, "Listen, I'm going to take a band in and gee, if you want the cornet part, you come on and join up." So, I did that for awhile. And, then, we got Joe Hooven in there and, of course, they needed a better reader than me to play those shows. So, of course, naturally, Hooven and I being such good friends, I talked up a storm for him and they got him in. And, uh, there was times that we used to - in my hotel room - we'd take a…
